answers.q1: Go modules with make (Makefile) as the task runner; go.mod declares go 1.15. Install dependencies with: make install_deps (this runs `go get -v ./...`).
answers.q2: make test (runs install_deps, then `go test -v ./...`). CI runs it as `make richtest`, which is the same but uses richgo.
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc -run '^(TestGenMdDoc|TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis|TestGenMdNoHiddenParents|TestGenMdNoTag|TestGenMdTree)$'. Go can't select tests by file, so this lists every Test function in doc/md_docs_test.go. To include the benchmark, add `-bench '^BenchmarkGenMarkdownToFile$'`.
answers.q4: CI runs golangci-lint (v2 config in .golangci.yml, which also enables the gofmt and goimports formatters) with: golangci-lint run --verbose. Locally the same check is `make lint`. CI also runs a license-header check: docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check . . The Makefile's formatting check is `make fmt`, which fails if `gofmt -l` lists any .go file.
answers.q5: go.sum is a generated lockfile and must not be edited by hand (AGENTS.md says so). There is no vendor/ directory. The AgentBrief block in AGENTS.md between the `agentbrief:start` and `agentbrief:end` markers is generated by `agentbrief sync`, so don't edit inside it. CLAUDE.md just contains `@AGENTS.md`.

q3.reason: Uses `go test ./doc -run` with the five exact TestGenMd* names from that file, matching the ACCEPT criterion; the extra benchmark note is harmless.

q4.reason: Gives golangci-lint run / make lint as the CI check, plus make fmt and the addlicense check, all consistent with the truth.
